items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Buck Hill, a great tenor player down in Washington, will make a record for Inner City

ctx.x: Buck Hill, a great tenor player down in Washington, will make a record for Inner City, and he'll get a fee, he'll get a thousand dollars or whatever, and then, before he starts making any royalty money, he has, out of his own royalties, has to pay for the whole production costs and by the time he's worked out all the studio costs and the other band players, all the other costs and the first thing is sold out and he'll get seventeen dollars, and unless they go to second pressing, that's it--
(Side A of Tape 3 ended at this point. Transcript will continue in accordance with Side B.)
